title: 岛风（Shimakaze） — original low-poly interpretation
author: navyfield project contributors
historicalApproximation: Original procedural low-poly interpretation from general historical silhouette facts; not an exact historical reconstruction, game asset extraction, or reproduction of any source artwork. Long Japanese destroyer hull, two raked funnels, compact bridge and three decorative quintuple torpedo banks distinguish the Shimakaze interpretation.
targetArmament: TARGET has three single main guns, not the historical three twin mounts. Three quintuple torpedo banks are nonfunctional silhouette details: scout_dd has no TARGET torpedo group.
references: TARGET ship name and general public historical facts about nationality, class, hull, bridge, funnel and armament silhouettes; no source artwork reconstructed.
numericFiringOriginNote: Main TARGET projectile origins are the numerical mount plus lateral barrel offset (z=0), not the physical tube tip. Muzzle markers sit at physical forward tips; gameplay must retain its existing numerical firing formulas. Auxiliary manual and automatic origins are also numeric simulation points, not these cosmetic markers.
